decisions.reason: The glass flake spraying system was launched only a year ago and is merely mentioned on the website, so its value is still uncertain, and keeping it in the portfolio of a spraying-equipment maker costs little while the option stays valuable.
The low-pressure injection pump has a page of its own, which signals a firmer commitment and fits the core pump business, so too little has been learned to justify abandoning it after one year.
The material transfer pump is a cheap extension of the existing pump range whose uncertainty is not yet resolved, so keeping the option open is sensible despite its low website visibility.
Fire protection flow monitoring opens a new market with its own dedicated page, and its prospects are still uncertain enough that the firm should wait for more evidence before deciding to drop it.
